svg.title: The eight-qubit cluster state C-8-2
svg.desc: Four qubits from photon A, labeled q1 through q4, form a horizontal chain connected by CZ and CNOT gates. Each of these four qubits also connects downward to one qubit from photon B, labeled q8, q7, q6, q5 respectively, via a native SPDC pairing edge that required no additional gate. Photon B's four qubits have no edges among themselves.
svg.text: CZ / CNOT on photon A's MPLC
